title: The Breakfast Where BioNTech Turned From Cancer to Covid-19
conflicts: Decision date: Türeci told AP (Dec 2020) the breakfast decision was on 24 January, and AFP repeats that; in the Döpfner interview (Mar 2021) Şahin says he read the Lancet paper on the Friday evening and the breakfast is placed on 25 January. The story says Friday evening for the reading and 'that weekend' for the decision. Efficacy: NYT's interim 'more than 90%' versus the final 95% (AFP, AP, NEJM); the story uses 95%. Trial size: Şahin's 'more than 40,000 volunteers' versus NEJM's 43,548; the story uses NEJM.
notes: Quote stance: affirms. Originals at pfizer.com and investors.biontech.de return 403, so press-agency and newspaper reprints that load are cited instead. The WSJ headcount of about 1,500 describes October 2020, so no January headcount is given.
